investigation_scope: Post-2022 GitHub and OSV public advisory mining

verified_high_confidence_records.description: Arbitrary code execution via python exec

rejected_ambiguous_records.notes: Third-party audit confirmed human author; false social media rumor attributing to Copilot.
Protocol specification vulnerability; purely human engineering.
Commit has Co-authored-by Copilot, but function was copied from legacy OpenTelemetry C++ repo.

scientific_findings.finding_1: GitHub Co-authored-by trailers frequently indicate general IDE auto-completion across the repository, but rarely isolate whether the specific vulnerable statement was synthesized by the model.
scientific_findings.finding_2: In-the-wild post-2022 C/C++ CVEs with rigorous, publicly auditable LLM provenance logs remain extremely sparse (<50 documented cases across all of NVD/OSV).
scientific_findings.finding_3: Attempting to force an artificial 400-sample target from real-world data would necessitate accepting ambiguous Co-authored-by trailers, which introduces severe label noise.
scientific_findings.recommendation: Maintain strict separation: report verified high-confidence real-world case studies independently, and rely on controlled multi-stage benchmarks for rigorous quantitative model evaluation.
